# FUN MOOC

> > France's leading free online learning platform offering MOOCs and micro-certifications from top universities and research institutions.

FUN MOOC (France Université Numérique) is a French MOOC platform providing free online courses, professional training, and micro-certifications from major universities and institutions. The platform serves learners across multiple disciplines including business, healthcare, languages, education, and emerging technologies.

## Key Topics

- MOOC
- micro-certification

## Core Platform

- [FUN MOOC - Main Platform](https://www.fun-mooc.fr): FUN MOOC main landing page with course catalog and platform overview
- [FUN MOOC - French Version](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr): FUN MOOC homepage: Free online courses from top French universities
- [About FUN MOOC](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/a-propos): About FUN MOOC: Organization overview and mission of France Université Numérique
- [Member Institutions](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/etablissements): Directory of member institutions and partner universities on FUN MOOC

## Support & Resources

- [FAQ & Tutorials](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/faq): FAQ and tutorial videos answering common questions about FUN MOOC platform
- [News & Announcements](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/actualites): News feed and announcements about courses, platform updates, and events

## Business & Entrepreneurship Courses

- [Market Research: Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/cours/realiser-son-etude-de-marche-pas-a-pas): Market research course: Step-by-step guide for business strategy planning
- [Business Acquisition & Sustainability Strategy](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/cours/reprise-dentreprise-et-durabilite-la-strategie-gagnante): Business acquisition course: Strategy and sustainability in corporate takeovers

## Education & Training Courses

- [Learner Engagement & Persistence in Training](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/cours/favoriser-lengagement-et-la-persistance-en-formation): Instructor training: Strategies for learner engagement and persistence
- [Outdoor Education Methods](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/cours/enseigner-en-exterieur): Teacher training: Outdoor education methods and pedagogical innovation

## Health & Science Courses

- [Viral Hepatitis: Virology & Treatment](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/cours/viral-hepatitis): Medical education course: Virology, epidemiology, and treatment of viral hepatitis
- [Hydrogen: Transport & Storage](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/cours/hydrogen-transport-and-storage): Hydrogen infrastructure course: Technical and economic challenges in transport

## Languages & International Courses

- [Malagasy Language Contact Kit](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/cours/kit-de-contact-en-langues-orientales-malgache): Beginner Malagasy language course with travel phrases and cultural context
- [Human Rights & Civic Space in Africa](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/cours/protection-des-droits-humains-et-de-lespace-civique-en-afrique): Human rights and civic space course for Francophone Africa with capacity-building

- [Webinar: Ludopedagogic Session Design](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/actualites/webinaire-comprendre-la-formation-animer-une-seance-ludopedagogi): Webinar: Ludopedagogic session design and evaluation with Université de Lille
- [Webinar: Legal Foundations of Healthcare Practice](https://www.fun-mooc.fr/fr/actualites/webinaire-comprendre-la-formation-fondements-juridiques-de-lexer): Webinar: Legal foundations of healthcare practice micro-certification
